items.headline: Xi-Trump summit outcomes
North Korea decries medical aid, says ‘nothing to give or receive’ from Seoul
items.detail: North Korea’s Kim Yo-jong, the powerful sister of ‌leader Kim Jong-un, denounced on Thursday South Korea’s plans to provide medical equipment aid to Pyongyang, calling it a “political provocation” and violation of its sovereignty.
